title: Read the Pair, Not One Number

scenes.tts: One blood sample gives you one number. What can it tell you? A hormone level is one point on a moving curve. Hormones are released in pulses, then cleared. Growth hormone left plasma with an average half-life of twenty-seven minutes. That was one small study's mean, after a large intravenous dose in five people. A sample drawn just before a pulse can read many times lower than one drawn on its peak.
scenes.visual: one sample, one number with a question mark; it becomes a point riding a drawn pulsatile curve (in this sketch), half-life bracket, two sample points: before a pulse and on the peak
scenes.narration: One blood sample gives you one number. What can it tell you? A hormone level is one point on a moving curve. Hormones are released in pulses, then cleared. Growth hormone left plasma with an average half-life of twenty-seven minutes. That was one small study's mean, after a large intravenous dose in five people. A sample drawn just before a pulse can read many times lower than one drawn on its peak.

scenes.tts: So read two hormones together. Take the cortisol axis. C R H, helped by vasopressin, drives A C T H from the pituitary. A C T H drives the adrenal cortex to make cortisol. Call A C T H the trophic hormone and cortisol the target hormone. Cortisol then feeds back on C R H and A C T H. That is long-loop feedback, with strong evidence at both levels.
scenes.visual: three labelled blocks in the lesson's order, CRH and ACTH arrows, cortisol arrow, long-loop feedback bars back to pituitary and hypothalamus
scenes.caption: So read two hormones together. Take the cortisol axis. CRH, helped by vasopressin, drives ACTH from the pituitary. ACTH drives the adrenal cortex to make cortisol. Call ACTH the trophic hormone and cortisol the target hormone. Cortisol then feeds back on CRH and ACTH. That is long-loop feedback, with strong evidence at both levels.
scenes.narration: So read two hormones together. Take the cortisol axis. CRH, helped by vasopressin, drives ACTH from the pituitary. ACTH drives the adrenal cortex to make cortisol. scenes.tts: Now break the chain at the gland. In this made-up example, adults on a normal sleep-wake schedule have blood drawn at eight in the morning. Person A has cortisol of 3 micrograms per decilitre and A C T H of 300 picograms per millilitre. Low cortisol should make an intact pituitary drive hard, and it does. The adrenal does not answer: that is the primary pattern. Reference intervals differ by laboratory and assay.
scenes.visual: person A: adrenal block marked as the lesion, cortisol gauge low 3, ACTH gauge high 300, weak feedback
scenes.caption: Now break the chain at the gland. In this made-up example, adults on a normal sleep-wake schedule have blood drawn at 08:00. Person A has cortisol of 3 µg per dL and ACTH of 300 pg per mL. Low cortisol should make an intact pituitary drive hard, and it does. The adrenal does not answer: that is the primary pattern. Reference intervals differ by laboratory and assay.

scenes.tts: Person B has the same low cortisol, but A C T H is only 5 picograms per millilitre. The drive itself is missing. That points to the pituitary, a secondary disorder, or to the hypothalamus, a tertiary one. The pair cannot say which, because either lesion lowers A C T H. It can separate gland disease from central disease.
scenes.visual: person B: low cortisol 3 and low ACTH 5; two candidate lesion markers alternate on pituitary and hypothalamus with question mark
scenes.caption: Person B has the same low cortisol, but ACTH is only 5 pg per mL. The drive itself is missing. It can separate gland disease from central disease.

scenes.tts: Now change one input and watch the output. Person B receives synthetic A C T H. Thirty minutes later, cortisol is 16 micrograms per decilitre. Whether that is adequate depends on the assay, because criteria for newer, more specific assays sit below the historical one. An adequate response shows only that the adrenal can answer A C T H. After a recent loss of central drive, the adrenal cortex may not yet have atrophied. So a normal result does not exclude a recent pituitary or hypothalamic defect.
scenes.visual: synthetic ACTH enters at the adrenal block; cortisol gauge rises to 16 after 30 min; assay tag; adrenal answers; upstream question mark stays

scenes.tts: The thyroid reads the same way. High T S H with low free T four is the classical primary pattern. Low free T four with low or inappropriately normal T S H points to central disease. A hormone level is a point on a moving curve, and a criterion belongs to its assay. Read hormones as pairs, and know which assay made the number.
scenes.visual: thyroid axis with the same wiring: primary pattern then central pattern; then the rule words
scenes.caption: The thyroid reads the same way. High TSH with low free T4 is the classical primary pattern. Low free T4 with low or inappropriately normal TSH points to central disease.
